marks.gloss_en: לפי שאינן בני תורה -- the leniency was withheld from them
ואמר רבא: ביום טוב שני יתעסקו בו ישראל -- Rava lets Jews attend to the dead on the second Festival day (part of the same איני; kind svara under protest)
לפי שאינן בני תורה -- the leniency was withheld from them
Rava: one who died on the first Festival day -- gentiles attend to him

there was an incident in the Maon synagogue on a Festival adjoining Shabbat -- and I do not know whether before it or after it -- and they came before R' Yochanan, and he said: let gentiles attend to him
[the mishna:] and one may put an egg into a [mustard] strainer
[the mishna:] and [one may filter wine] with an Egyptian basket
מאי שנא מדרב הונא -- an unfringed garment's fringes make one liable for carrying, so why are the canopy's straps permitted? (amoraic-memra contradiction; kind svara under protest, rule 12)
ציצית לגבי טלית חשיבי ולא בטלי, הני לא חשיבי ובטלי (= p_tzitzit_lo_batlei, p_kiskasim_batlei)
one who goes out on Shabbat in a garment that is not fringed as required is liable a sin-offering
מאי שנא מהא דתניא ... מערים ושותה מן החדש -- the beer artifice needs no demonstrated permitted use, so why must he actually hang pomegranates?
one may brew beer on the moed for the needs of the moed
התם לא מוכחא מילתא, הכא מוכחא מילתא (= p_shechar_lo_mochcha, p_meshameret_mochcha)
there [the beer] the matter is not evident
a person may wrap himself in a canopy and its straps and go out to the public domain on Shabbat, without concern
a person may use artifice with a strainer on Yom Tov -- [suspending it] to hang pomegranates in it -- and [then] hang sediment in it
[the young scholar] took a garlic slice and put it in the barrel's spout, and said: I intend to store it
[this] artifice is in a rabbinic matter
one may put water over sediment so that it clarifies
and one may put an egg into a mustard strainer
משום דמיחזי כמשמרת -- Rav Pappa's own reason for his prohibition
Rav Pappa: a person may not press a bundle of straw into the mouth of the spigot
אמר ליה רב אחא מדיפתי לרבינא: הא איכא ניצוצות! -- but there are the last drops
ניצוצות לבי רב פפא לא חשיבי -- the drops are not significant to Rav Pappa's household (= p_nitzotzot_lo_chashivi)
Rav Pappa's household would pour beer from vessel to vessel
Rav: this pronka -- [spread] over half the barrel, it is permitted
[the mishna:] one may filter wine with cloths
מיתיבי, רשב"ג: טורד אדם חבית של יין יינה ושמריה ונותן לתוך המשמרת -- stirred, murky wine is permitted!
תרגמה זעירי: בין הגיתות שנו (= p_zeiri_bein_hagitot)
a person may stir a barrel of wine, its wine and its sediment, and put it into a strainer on Shabbat without concern
a person may put clear wine and clear water into a strainer on Shabbat without concern
